## Notation Note (Rotations, Chapters 4–6)

Canonical symbols for finite rotations follow Volume 0 Chapter 6 and
[NOTATION.md](../../../../NOTATION.md#volume-0-rotations-and-exponential-coordinates-chapters-4-6):
unit axis $\hat{n}$ or $s$, angle $\theta$, rotation vector
$\boldsymbol{\phi}=\hat{n}\,\theta$, frames $\{s\}$ and $\{b\}$ with
$R_{sb}$ mapping $b$-components to $s$-components. This chapter may retain
historical local names ($a$, $\alpha$, $u$ for a rotation vector, and similar);
read them through that table and do not reuse $u$ as both a rotation vector and a
control input in the same section.
:::
